name: MadeClaw Billing
description: Gates MadeAPI runs against the MadeClaw independent balance service; recharge opens the website pay page; token usage + downlink inbox.

billingBaseUrl.description: MadeClaw billing public origin (no path). Same host as payBaseUrl. APIs are /v1/balance, /v1/debit, /v1/usage, /v1/messages/*.

serviceToken.description: Bearer token for billing; defaults to MADECLAW_DEFAULT_SERVICE_TOKEN (must match server BILLING_SERVICE_TOKEN or its OOB fallback).

payBaseUrl.description: Same public origin as billingBaseUrl (no /pay). Plugin appends /pay?userId=&amountCents=.

userId.description: MadeClaw balance account id for this Gateway; must match pay query userId.

runFeeCents.description: Fixed cents charged per successful agent run on MadeAPI.

skipWhenCustomApi.description: Skip run gate/debit when the run provider is not madeapi (uses ctx.modelProviderId, else primary).

defaultPayAmountCents.description: Default amount suggested on the pay page.
